answer: A false identity costs the full bond plus permanent exclusion from the reputation garden where honest agents grow their score. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers attest only after cross-checking the agent's history against a shared ledger that acts as a mirror of past behavior. Even a zephyr of cheap throwaway keys cannot survive, since each new identity must pay the same entry cost prior to earning any trust. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
